node.statement: For every n>=1, set R_n=I_n tensor R. By lem-compcb-amplified-compression with delta=epsilon=t and P=Q=R, Co_{R_n}=1_{M_n} tensor Co_R and S_{R_n}=M_n tensor S_R. Hence the level-one conclusions Co_R=I_A and S_R=A imply Co_{R_n}=I_{M_n tensor A} and S_{R_n}=M_n tensor A for every n, which is exactly the asserted conclusion at every amplification.
